scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push && npm run data:validate && npm run db:import
scripts.diosc:vocab:probe: python scripts/vocab_multi_agent_pilot.py --csv data-workbench/entries_diosc.csv --id-col entry_id --text-col greek --prompt docs/prompts/vocab_term_extractor_with_degrees_diosc.md --n 1 --outdir outputs/vocab_entries_v3 --run-id diosc_smoke_probe --model gpt-5.2 -c model_reasoning_effort="high" --parallel 1 --timeout 900 --retries 0
scripts.diosc:vocab:smoke: python scripts/vocab_multi_agent_pilot.py --csv data-workbench/entries_diosc.csv --id-col entry_id --text-col greek --prompt docs/prompts/vocab_term_extractor_with_degrees_diosc.md --n 25 --outdir outputs/vocab_entries_v3 --run-id diosc_smoke_v3 --model gpt-5.2 -c model_reasoning_effort="high" --parallel 5 --timeout 900 --retries 2
scripts.diosc:vocab:smoke:resume: python scripts/vocab_multi_agent_pilot.py --csv data-workbench/entries_diosc.csv --id-col entry_id --text-col greek --prompt docs/prompts/vocab_term_extractor_with_degrees_diosc.md --n 25 --outdir outputs/vocab_entries_v3 --run-id diosc_smoke_v3 --model gpt-5.2 -c model_reasoning_effort="high" --parallel 3 --timeout 900 --retries 2 --resume
scripts.diosc:vocab:run: python scripts/vocab_multi_agent_pilot.py --csv data-workbench/entries_diosc.csv --id-col entry_id --text-col greek --prompt docs/prompts/vocab_term_extractor_with_degrees_diosc.md --n 100000 --outdir outputs/vocab_entries_v3 --run-id diosc_full_v3 --model gpt-5.2 -c model_reasoning_effort="high" --parallel 10 --timeout 900 --retries 2 --resume
scripts.ci: npm run data:validate && npm run app:lint && npm run app:build
